steps.en: Latest email of the company hirer is fetched from the data source
steps.id: Email terbaru hirer perusahaan diambil dari sumber data
steps.why_en: The data source lookup is turned off in all environments, so the email typed by the owner is used.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan ke sumber data dimatikan di semua environment, jadi email yang diketik owner yang dipakai.

steps.en: Unique company hirers are identified and their notices combined in one email
steps.id: Hirer perusahaan yang unik diidentifikasi dan NOPO-nya digabung dalam satu email
steps.why_en: Notices with different due dates still produce separate emails to the same company.
steps.why_id: NOPO dengan tanggal jatuh tempo berbeda tetap jadi email terpisah ke perusahaan yang sama.

steps.en: Opted-out or no-email company hirers are not emailed
steps.id: Hirer perusahaan opt-out atau tanpa email tidak dikirimi email

steps.en: The email lists the outstanding notices and refers to the 1st letter
steps.id: Email memuat NOPO outstanding dan merujuk ke 1st letter
steps.why_en: The message wording is stored in the database and cannot be checked from the code.
steps.why_id: Isi pesan disimpan di database dan tidak bisa dicek dari code.

steps.en: The email is sent to company hirers in a batch
steps.id: Email dikirim ke hirer perusahaan dalam satu batch
steps.why_en: Email sending and the reminder job are both switched off in the production settings.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman email dan job reminder sama-sama dimatikan di setting produksi.
